messages:
noah: confession time — I found a mismatched mug in the dish rack and I think it belongs to the legendary unicorn mug. Who's responsible for the Great Unicorn Migration? :unicorn_face:

lina: wait, is this about the mug with the tiny scar by the handle? i've seen it. it appears only on Fridays. :thinking_face:

maya: omg the scar is the proof. that’s Sir Mugsworth. he has an entire origin story.

jeff: (raises hand) not me. i only drink from the Thermos of Destiny. :thermos:

noah: @maya tell the origin story again, please. office tradition demand.

maya: fine. once upon a late deploy there was a mug that refused to be labeled. it wandered desks, picked up stickers, and developed a scar during the Great Coffee Spill of '23. it now chooses its humans. rumor says it prefers people who push to main at 6pm. :hourglass_flowing_sand:

lina: can we make a shrine? small shelf near the coffee grinder? with name tags like "current chosen" and "last seen".

jeff: vote: shrine or no shrine? 1 for shrine, 2 for no shrine. i'll tally.

noah: 1

maya: 1

tara: 2 (i will guard the Thermos of Destiny’s dignity but not a shrine pls)

ops-bot: Reminder: free office mugs are personal property. Please use the Lost & Found form if you find someone else's item: https://redwood/internal/lostfound (auto) :bell:

lina: ALSO side poll: best hiding spot for a prank mug swap — under the ficus, inside the top shelf of the supply closet, or taped under the standing desk?

maya: under the ficus, 100% (it becomes part of the plant ecosystem) :deciduous_tree:

jeff: taped under the standing desk, lol.

noah: end result: we return the unicorn mug to whoever claims it by Friday. if no one claims, we consecrate it on the coffee shrine and call it "Office Lore: Sir Mugsworth". who volunteers to write the plaque?

maya: i will. short haiku only.

lina: agreed. haiku or small plaque. low effort, high myth. :sparkles:

jeff: tagging facilities so we don’t accidentally toss Sir Mugsworth during closet cleanup next week. @ops-bot please ping facilities?

ops-bot: Ping sent to #facilities. ETA response: 24-48h. :white_check_mark:

noah: perfect. this thread is now the official origin myth. future archaeologists will thank us. :museum:

maya: archival note: add backup coffee photo to the company lore folder. I have a picture. :)
